title: Direct Deposit Rate Tiers for Pocketwire Personal Account Instant Cash-Outs
content:
Customers who receive their pay by direct deposit into the Pocketwire Personal Account are priced on a lower instant fee rate tier.

**Rule.** The deposit rate tier of the instant fee rate reads the direct deposit measure and the count of direct deposits dated in the last month:

- when the measure reaches USD 2000.00 and 2 or more deposits are dated in the last month, the tier is the plan's direct-deposit instant fee rate less 0.50 percentage points;
- when the measure reaches the plan's direct-deposit benefit threshold without meeting both of those conditions, it is the plan's direct-deposit instant fee rate;
- otherwise it is the plan's instant transfer fee rate.

"Reaches" means at or above. A deposit is dated in the last month when it is dated later than the same calendar day one month before the handling date.

### Tier figures by plan (rates in percent, threshold in USD)

| Plan | Direct-deposit benefit threshold | Top tier (direct-deposit rate less 0.50) | Direct-deposit instant fee rate | Instant transfer fee rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Lite | 500.00 | 1.25 | 1.75 | 1.75 |
| Pocketwire Core | 500.00 | 1.00 | 1.50 | 1.75 |
| Pocketwire Plus | 500.00 | 0.75 | 1.25 | 1.50 |
| Pocketwire Prime | 300.00 | 0.50 | 1.00 | 1.25 |
| Pocketwire Onyx | 300.00 | 0.00 | 0.50 | 0.75 |
| Pocketwire Summit | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.50 | 0.50 |

### Condition table

| Measure at or above 2000.00 | 2 or more deposits in the last month | Measure at or above the plan's threshold | Tier |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes | Direct-deposit rate less 0.50 |
| Yes | No | Yes | Direct-deposit rate |
| No | Yes or no | Yes | Direct-deposit rate |
| No | Yes or no | No | Instant transfer fee rate |

### Cases (hypothetical)

- Pocketwire Plus, measure 2400.00, three deposits in the last month: 0.75.
- Pocketwire Plus, measure 2400.00, one deposit in the last month: 1.25.
- Pocketwire Prime, measure 280.00: 1.25 — below 300.00.
- Pocketwire Summit, measure 0.00: the threshold of 0.00 is reached, so 0.50.
